# Swipe

Header: `winui/ui/scrolling/Swipe.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/scrolling/Swipe.hpp`.

Reveals a strip of action items beside its content when the content is dragged sideways: the "swipe a list row to reveal Delete/Archive" pattern.

Dragging right reveals the left items, and dragging left the right ones. The control owns its content, which stays fully interactive. The items work with the mouse only and are not exposed to accessibility tools. The declarative form is [ui::Swipe](#uiswipe).

Example: 
```cpp
void reply();      // the app's own
void delete_row(); // the app's own
ui::SwipeItem reply_item{ .text = "Reply", .icon = ui::IconGlyph{0xE8C2}, .on_invoked = [&] { reply(); } };
ui::SwipeItem delete_item{ .text       = "Delete",
                           .icon       = ui::IconGlyph{0xE74D},
                           .background = ui::theme_colors::Critical,
                           .on_invoked = [&] { delete_row(); } };

window.set_content(ui::Swipe{
    .left_items  = { reply_item },
    .right_items = { delete_item },
    .right_mode  = ui::SwipeMode::Execute,
    .height      = 68,
    .content     = ui::Text{ .text               = "Swipe me",
                             .margin             = ui::Thickness{12},
                             .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Center },
});

// Imperatively:
auto swipe = std::make_unique<ui::SwipeControl>();
swipe->set_content(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Swipe me"));
swipe->set_left_items({ .items = { reply_item } });
swipe->set_right_items({ .items = { delete_item }, .mode = ui::SwipeMode::Execute });
```

## `ui::Swipe`

Reveals a strip of action items when its child is dragged sideways, as a list row's swipe actions. Builds a [ui::SwipeControl](#uiswipecontrol). The callbacks are on each [ui::SwipeItem](#struct-swipeitem), so the spec has no `.on_*` handler of its own for them.

Example: 
```cpp
struct Row { std::string name; };

ui::Spec swipe_row(const Row& row, std::function<void()> remove) // captures by value
{
    return ui::Swipe{
        .left_items  = {{.text = "Flag", .icon = ui::Symbol::Flag}},
        .right_items = {{.text       = "Delete",
                         .background = ui::Color::from_rgba(196, 43, 28),
                         .on_invoked = [remove] { remove(); }}},
        .right_mode  = ui::SwipeMode::Execute,
        .content     = ui::Text{.text = row.name, .margin = ui::Thickness{12.0f}},
    };
}
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Swipe{
    .left_items, .left_mode, .right_items, .right_mode, .background, .border_brush,
    .border_thickness, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled,
    .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uiswipe-left_items"></span>`left_items` | `ui::Binding<std::vector<ui::SwipeItem>>` |  | Revealed by dragging the content to the right. |
| <span id="uiswipe-left_mode"></span>`left_mode` | `ui::SwipeMode` | `ui::SwipeMode::Reveal` | Reveal, the default, shows the items to click. Execute invokes the single item on release. |
| <span id="uiswipe-right_items"></span>`right_items` | `ui::Binding<std::vector<ui::SwipeItem>>` |  | Revealed by dragging the content to the left. |
| <span id="uiswipe-right_mode"></span>`right_mode` | `ui::SwipeMode` | `ui::SwipeMode::Reveal` | As [`left_mode`](#uiswipe-left_mode), for [`right_items`](#uiswipe-right_items). |
| <span id="uiswipe-background"></span>`background` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | The fill, border color and border width behind the content, which move with it. A color is fixed or a theme resource, read again when the theme changes. |
| <span id="uiswipe-border_brush"></span>`border_brush` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | See [`background`](#uiswipe-background). |
| <span id="uiswipe-border_thickness"></span>`border_thickness` | `ui::Binding<ui::Thickness>` |  | See [`background`](#uiswipe-background). |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uiswipe-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uiswipe-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Swipe>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uiswipe-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The row content that slides to reveal the items. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::SwipeControl](#uiswipecontrol); the caller owns it.

## `ui::SwipeControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`.

Reveals a strip of action items beside its content when the content is dragged sideways: the "swipe a list row to reveal Delete/Archive" pattern.

Dragging right reveals the left items, and dragging left the right ones. The control owns its content, which stays fully interactive. The items work with the mouse only and are not exposed to accessibility tools. The declarative form is [ui::Swipe](#uiswipe).

Example: 
```cpp
void reply();      // the app's own
void delete_row(); // the app's own
ui::SwipeItem reply_item{ .text = "Reply", .icon = ui::IconGlyph{0xE8C2}, .on_invoked = [&] { reply(); } };
ui::SwipeItem delete_item{ .text       = "Delete",
                           .icon       = ui::IconGlyph{0xE74D},
                           .background = ui::theme_colors::Critical,
                           .on_invoked = [&] { delete_row(); } };

window.set_content(ui::Swipe{
    .left_items  = { reply_item },
    .right_items = { delete_item },
    .right_mode  = ui::SwipeMode::Execute,
    .height      = 68,
    .content     = ui::Text{ .text               = "Swipe me",
                             .margin             = ui::Thickness{12},
                             .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Center },
});

// Imperatively:
auto swipe = std::make_unique<ui::SwipeControl>();
swipe->set_content(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Swipe me"));
swipe->set_left_items({ .items = { reply_item } });
swipe->set_right_items({ .items = { delete_item }, .mode = ui::SwipeMode::Execute });
```

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Visits the content, the only child. The control itself is not focusable, and whatever is focusable in the content is always in the tab order. The items are not children: they work with the mouse only and are not exposed to accessibility tools.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The content's size plus the border, and at least an item's minimum height while there are items to reveal. Also measures the items' widths.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Arranges the content inside the border. [offset()](#offset) shifts it only when drawing.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the revealed strip, then the background, border and content shifted by [offset()](#offset).

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A horizontal drag moves the strip and takes the gesture from the content. A tap on an item invokes it, and a tap on the content while open closes the strip.

### handled_pointer_override

```cpp
void handled_pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A press and release the content took still start and end a drag, so a swipe can begin on a button.

### covers_children_at

```cpp
bool covers_children_at(Point p) const override
```

Open or dragged, the strip covers the content.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Ticks the content, then advances the 250 ms snap, invoking an Execute item as it settles.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

## struct SwipeItem

One action in a [SwipeControl](#uiswipecontrol)'s strip: a label under an icon, its own colors, and what happens when it is invoked. A value type, built with designated initializers and handed over in a [SwipeItems](#struct-swipeitems) list.

Example: 
```cpp
void archive_message(); // the app's own
ui::SwipeItem archive{
    .text       = "Archive",
    .icon       = ui::IconGlyph{0xE7B8},
    .background = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF3E6FA7),
    .foreground = ui::colors::White,
    .on_invoked = [&] { archive_message(); },
};
```

### text

```cpp
std::string text {}
```

The text. Falls back to the command's text.

### icon

```cpp
IconSource icon {}
```

The icon, drawn 16 DIPs tall above the text. Falls back to the command's icon.

### background

```cpp
Paint background {}
```

A color, a brush or a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md). In Execute mode a gradient spans the whole control. Empty uses the theme's item background in Reveal, and in Execute the theme's two colors for before and after the swipe passes its threshold.

### foreground

```cpp
std::optional<Color> foreground {}
```

The text and icon color. Unset uses the theme's item foreground, which in Execute is a pair for before and after the threshold.

### behavior_on_invoked

```cpp
SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked behavior_on_invoked = SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked::Auto
```

What the strip does after the item is invoked.

### command

```cpp
CommandRef command {}
```

A command run after [`on_invoked`](#on_invoked), while it is enabled. Its text and icon fill the text and icon left empty.

### command_parameter

```cpp
std::string command_parameter {}
```

Handed to the command's execute.

### on_invoked

```cpp
SwipeItemInvokedHandler on_invoked {}
```

Fires on a tap in Reveal mode or a completed swipe in Execute mode, before the command runs.

### display_text

```cpp
std::string display_text() const
```

The text drawn: [`text`](#text), or the command's text when [`text`](#text) is empty.

### display_icon

```cpp
const IconSource& display_icon() const
```

The icon drawn: [`icon`](#icon), or the command's icon when [`icon`](#icon) is empty.

## struct SwipeItemInvokedEventArgs

The arguments of an item's on_invoked: the item that was invoked, whose text or icon the handler may change, and the control it was swiped from.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `swipe_control` | `SwipeControl&` |  | The control the item was swiped from. |
| `item` | `SwipeItem&` |  | The invoked item. Its text and icon may be changed here. |

## class SwipeItemInvokedHandler

[SwipeItem::on_invoked](#on_invoked)'s handler: a callable that takes the event args, or one that takes nothing.

Copyable, since [SwipeItem](#struct-swipeitem) lives in a std::vector that a caller builds with a brace list.

Example: 
```cpp
bool flagged = false;
ui::SwipeItem flag{ .text = "Flag", .on_invoked = [&] { flagged = true; } };
ui::SwipeItem mark_read{ .text       = "Mark read",
                         .on_invoked = [](ui::SwipeItemInvokedEventArgs& e) { e.item.text = "Marked"; } };
```

### SwipeItemInvokedHandler

```cpp
SwipeItemInvokedHandler() = default
```

No handler. Invoking it does nothing.

### SwipeItemInvokedHandler

```cpp
template <typename F>
SwipeItemInvokedHandler(F handler)
    requires std::invocable<F&> || std::invocable<F&, SwipeItemInvokedEventArgs&>
```

Wraps a callable taking [`SwipeItemInvokedEventArgs&`](#struct-swipeiteminvokedeventargs), or one taking nothing.


## struct SwipeItems

One side's items and how they are revealed. An Execute set shows a single item, as wide as the control.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `std::vector<SwipeItem>` |  | The strip's items, in order from the left. |
| `mode` | `SwipeMode` | `SwipeMode::Reveal` | Reveal (a drawer) or Execute (swipe to run). |

## Enumerations

### SwipeMode

```cpp
enum class SwipeMode
```

How a [Swipe](#uiswipe) side shows its items. Reveal opens a drawer of items at their natural widths, as far as it is dragged. Execute shows one item as wide as the control, invoked by swiping it all the way, as in "swipe to archive".

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Reveal` | A drawer of items at their natural widths. A tap invokes one. |
| `Execute` | One item as wide as the control, invoked by swiping past the threshold. |

### SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked

```cpp
enum class SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked
```

What the strip does after an item is invoked. Auto closes, as Close does, in both modes.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Auto` | Close after the item runs. |
| `Close` | Close after the item runs. |
| `RemainOpen` | Leave the strip open after the item runs. |
